english.title: Pilot in command of aircraft about to tow glider fail to be satisfied of requirements in article 87(3)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which was about to tow a glider, failed to be satisfied, before the towing aircraft took off, that

(A)_[the tow rope was in good condition and was of adequate strength for the purpose]_
(B)_[the combination of towing aircraft and glider, having regard to its performance in the conditions to be expected on the intended flight and to any obstructions at the place of departure and on the intended route, was capable of safely taking off, reaching and maintaining a safe height at which to separate the combination]_
(C)_[after separation the towing aircraft could make a safe landing at the place of intended destination]_
(D)_[signals had been agreed and communication established with persons suitably stationed so as to enable the glider to take off safely]_
(E)_[emergency signals had been agreed between the pilot in command of the towing aircraft and the pilot in command of the glider, to be used, respectively, by the pilot in command of the towing aircraft to indicate that the tow should immediately be released by the glider, and by the pilot in command of the glider to indicate that the tow could not be released]_
(F)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 87(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
